_note: Upgrades sold in the Hardening shop. day is the day the upgrade belongs to: the shop sells the upgrades of the current day and of the earlier days. load is what the upgrade uses of the upgrade load (2 on Day 1, 2N on Day N). price is in Security Points. The icon is assets/upgrades/icon_<id>.png. Every upgrade does two things: its passive (ALWAYS: a general benefit in every fight, see response.gd _apply_passives; keys max_hp, block_per_turn, heal_per_turn, dodge_per_turn, attack_bonus, first_draw, first_energy) and its AGAINST effect (the attack pattern it counters, defined by the pattern's counter in the day's response data). text shows both. clues are the ids of the Investigation clues the upgrade answers: when the player found one, the Upgrade Editor recommends the upgrade.

unique.name: Unique Passwords
unique.against: One password, many accounts: one stolen password opens nothing else.
unique.text:
ALWAYS: +10 max HP.
AGAINST One password, many accounts: one stolen password opens nothing else.
